Services

Mobile app
development.

We build mobile apps for iOS and Android, from the first prototype to release on the App Store and Google Play. Where needed we also build a web dashboard to manage the app, and the same small team does it all, so you talk directly to the people building it.

Request a quote Book a consultation

What you get

  • iOS and Android

    Your app runs on iPhones and Android phones alike, so you reach all of your users.

  • Design and prototype

    Before any code is written, you get a clickable prototype to try out while changes are still easy to make.

  • User accounts

    Sign-up, login and user profiles, with different permissions for users and administrators.

  • Push notifications

    Reminders, confirmations and news reach your users' phones even when the app is closed.

  • Web dashboard

    An admin panel in the browser where you manage content, users and data without needing us.

  • Connected to your systems

    We connect the app via APIs to your website, business software or other services you already use.

  • Store release

    We help prepare the description, screenshots and everything else the App Store and Google Play ask for, and see the app through review.

  • Maintenance and updates

    New versions of iOS and Android come out every year. We keep your app working and add new features.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need a mobile app, or is a web app enough?

It depends on how people will use it. A mobile app makes sense if users open it often, need push notifications or want it on their home screen. For many business tools a custom web application, from €3,500, is enough. In the consultation we will tell you honestly which suits you better.

How long does it take to build a mobile app?

Usually 2–4 months, depending on complexity. We state the exact timeline in the offer, and it starts once we receive the materials and the advance payment.

Who owns the app and the code?

You do. Once you have paid the agreed price, all rights to the code and design created for your project pass to you.

What happens after launch?

We fix bugs reported within 3 months of handover free of charge. After that you can take out maintenance from €150 per month, with 30 days' notice, and new features are billed at €45 per hour or as per offer.

How does payment work?

Unless the offer says otherwise, you pay 50 % in advance and the rest on delivery. All conditions are set out in our terms and conditions.
